"Someday" is a song by Canadian pop band Glass Tiger.
It was released on 1986 as the third single from their debut studio album The Thin Red Line through Capitol Records in Canada and Manhattan Records worldwide.
The song was written by members Alan Frew and Al Connelly and by producer Jim Vallance.
